description: Geocoded Road Traffic Crashes in Nairobi, Kenya Derived from Crowdsourced Reports [2012 - 2023] is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by ieConnect for Impact. The datasets contain the time and location of road traffic crashes in Kenya (primarily Nairobi); crash information is derived from crowdsourced reports from @Ma3Route. Ma3Route is a mobile/web/SMS platform that crowdsources transport data and provides users with information on traffic, road traffic crash (RTC), matatu directions and driving reports. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher ieConnect for Impact. Its tags are road safety, road traffic crashes. The portal shows 2026-03-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
